title: Bangladesh Perfume Store: Website Research and 20-Product Bilingual Catalog
catalog_scope: International-brand perfumes listed by Bangladesh retailers; a proposed starter selection, not a verified national sales ranking.
research_limits: Reviewed public homepage navigation, catalog content, product pages and displayed delivery information. No purchases, payment submissions, authenticity audit, mobile performance benchmark or admin access.
Web retrieval can contain cached pages. Prices are retailer reference observations collected during this research and must be rechecked before commercial use.
Retailer stock, reviews, sales counts, authenticity claims, shipping rules and photography are not imported as this store's own data.
Fragrance descriptions are original short English/Bangla paraphrases. Key notes are retailer-referenced highlights, not complete ingredient lists or manufacturer-verified pyramids.

website_benchmarks.name: Sundora
observed: Fragrance families, concentration and gender categories
Gift shopping by budget and store locator
recommended_application: A focused brand directory and fragrance-family filters
Product identity and concentration displayed clearly
A compact navigation sized for a 20-product launch

website_benchmarks.name: Perfume Shop Bangladesh
observed: Budget-shopping sections, brands directory and best-seller sections
Product pages place delivery estimates and charges close to purchase controls
Hawas Ice page contains English and Bangla descriptive content
recommended_application: Address-dependent delivery information beside checkout controls
A complete EN/BN interface with translated navigation, product content, checkout and notifications

website_benchmarks.name: FragranceBD
observed: Recent products, best sellers, recommendations and sale sections
Product detail pages show fragrance notes and bottle options
recommended_application: Curated featured/new-arrival sections driven by admin settings
A compact scent profile and key-note section

website_benchmarks.name: Buy Perfume in Bangladesh (BPIB)
observed: Full bottles, decants, atomizers and gift sets
Individual product pages list full-bottle and decant offerings
Some decant ordering instructions use a 1 ml variation multiplied by quantity
recommended_application: Separate explicit full-bottle and decant purchase formats if decants are sold
Use direct 5 ml/10 ml options with their own price and inventory rules
Show a clear selected-format price and avoid presenting a decant starting price as a full-bottle price

recommended_storefront.positioning: A focused premium perfume store with simple local shopping.
recommended_storefront.visual_direction: Perfume Center-inspired white/light-gray surfaces, charcoal text, deep magenta accents, rounded cards, restrained shadows and consistent supplier-approved bottle photography.
homepage_sections: Compact header with own logo, populated categories, search, account, cart and EN/BN switch
Image-based category tiles linked to populated collections
catalog_filters: Purchase format if decants are offered
product_page: Canonical product name and optional Bangla display name
Selling price for the exact selected variant
recommended_storefront.trust_content: Publish the merchant's real sourcing, shipping and return policies. Only label an actual verified purchase as a verified review.

bilingual_implementation.product_identity: Exactly 20 product records, each holding both translations. Both languages share a product ID, variant SKUs, stock, prices, cart and orders.
bilingual_implementation.canonical_names: Retain canonical English brand and fragrance names in both languages; Bangla transliterations supplement recognition and search.
bilingual_implementation.language_switch: Preserve the current product/page, selected variant, cart and checkout session when switching languages; persist preference.
bilingual_implementation.search: Match English, Bangla and aliases; normalize Bengali/ASCII digits and Unicode consistently. Recognize Hawas, Hawais, হাওয়াস and common transliterations.
bilingual_implementation.seo: Render localized public content in initial HTML; set html lang to en or bn; give localized pages separate canonical URLs and reciprocal hreflang links.
bilingual_implementation.formatting: Format BDT using the active locale (en-BD/bn-BD). Keep EDP/EDT and SKUs stable. Normalize phone numbers and numeric input before validation.
bilingual_implementation.typography: Use a Bengali-capable typeface and test wrapping, line height, prices, mobile controls and checkout errors in both languages.
bilingual_implementation.translation_quality: Store editable authored translations. Require both languages before publication; use fallback only as an explicitly defined temporary behavior.

bn.free_shipping_remaining: ফ্রি ডেলিভারি পেতে আরও {amount} টাকার পণ্য যোগ করুন।

import_instructions: Create one product per slug and store both locales on that record or related translation rows.
Create exactly one suggested full-bottle variant per product in this file. Additional sizes require independent source and supplier verification.
Import as draft with zero stock and null selling prices. Keep retailer reference prices in research metadata, not live price fields.
Skip already-existing slugs by default; repeated imports must not reset manually entered prices, stock, translations, orders or product edits.
Collect actual supplier-confirmed stock, selling prices and authorized product photographs before publication. image_path null explicitly means the product image remains to be supplied.
Reference ranges and unmapped prices must never be assigned to a particular size automatically.
The seed does not establish authenticity, authorized dealership, popularity rank or sales history.

cursor_followup_prompt:
Update the existing public storefront using https://perfumecenter.com.bd/ as the primary visual and interaction reference. Inspect its homepage, shop and product pages before implementing.

Follow its compact header, wide promotional banner, image-based category tiles, rounded product cards, product collections, filter sidebar, cart drawer and large product-detail layout. Use white/light-gray surfaces, charcoal typography and deep magenta accents. Create original branding and use merchant-approved imagery.

Preserve the current Laravel/React/Inertia backend, administration, payments and inventory logic. Connect every visible control to working application behavior. Adapt navigation to our actual catalog and use BDT consistently.

Provide complete English/Bangla support for navigation, product content, search, filters, cart, checkout, validation and notifications. Switching language must preserve the current page, selected variant and cart. Use the 20 perfumes from this JSON, including Dior Sauvage and Rasasi Hawas, and follow its draft-import rules. Retailer reference prices must not become live selling prices automatically.

Make banners, category images, homepage collections and business details editable from administration. Render reviews, discounts, availability and delivery information from real store data. Ensure responsive layouts, readable Bangla, accessible controls and optimized images. Verify the shopping flow and production build, and report changed files and remaining merchant inputs.
